utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Good morning everybody in and around the courtroom. This is case IT-08-91-T, the Prosecutor versus Mico Stanisic and Stojan Zupljanin.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Registrar. Good morning to everyone. May we have the appearances, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. HANNIS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. And I note that again we're just sitting with the two of you, I take it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Thank you for reminding me, Mr. Hannis. Yes. For the record, we reconvene again under Rule 15 bis, Judge Harhoff being absent.

utterances.speaker: MR. HANNIS
utterances.text: And for the Prosecution, Your Honours, I'm Thomas Hannis, along with Matthew Olmsted and Crispian Smith.

utterances.speaker: MR. O'SULLIVAN
utterances.text: Your Honour, Eugene O'Sullivan and Deirdre Montgomery for Mr. Stanisic.

utterances.speaker: MR. KRGOVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Dragan Krgovic, Igor Pantelic, and Aleksandar Aleksic for Zupljanin Defence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Thank you. Before we go into closed session, the Chamber has an oral ruling. The Trial Chamber is seized of a Prosecution motion -- and I interrupt myself to say that there's a possibility the interpreters may not have this, so I will speak as slowly as possible. The Trial Chamber is seized of a Prosecution motion filed on the 14th of September, 2010, to amend the 65 ter list of exhibits by reinstating one document, Rule 65 ter number 505, a dispatch from CSB Banja Luka, dated the 4th of August, 1992, signed by the Accused Zupljanin. Yesterday, the Defence teams objected and the Prosecution replied orally. The Chamber is satisfied of the prima facie relevance and probative value of the document. Given that the document was disclosed to the Stanisic and Zupljanin Defence teams on the 13th of June, 2005, and the 14th of October, 2008, respectively, and until May of 2008, it was on the 65 ter list, it finds that the Defence have been on sufficient notice and that no prejudice will be suffered by the Defence by adding this half-page document to the Prosecution's 65 ter list of exhibits. For these reasons and in the interests of justice, the Chamber allows the addition of Rule 65 ter number 505 to the Prosecution's exhibit list. Thank you. And we may now go back into closed session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: And we are back in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. HANNIS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours. We have finished sooner than we anticipated. Now, I know we talked yesterday about Ms. Korner coming in and having some discussion about exhumations, et cetera. I don't know if she's aware that we've finished. When we spoke at the last break, it was anticipated we were probably going to take the rest of the day to finish this witness. My Case Manager's trying to reach her right now. I don't know what the Defence position is.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZECEVIC
utterances.text: Well, I'm pretty sure that Ms. Korner assumes that the amount of time that is left for us is nowhere near adequate for the submissions as we anticipated. So, therefore, I don't think we can start the submissions today, but as scheduled tomorrow after the finish of the next witness.

utterances.speaker: MR. HANNIS
utterances.text: The brief communication that my Case Manager's had with Ms. Korner corroborates what Mr. Zecevic just said. The next witness, ST-217, will be ready to start in the morning.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: Thank you. We will take the adjournment for today and reconvene tomorrow morning in this courtroom at 9.00.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HALL
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Friday, the 17th day of September, 2010, at 9.00 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.22 p.m.,
